newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Court awards 1.0 million Belgian francs to EP employee.
newsitem.headline: Court awards 1.0 million Belgian francs to EP employee.

text.p: The European Court of Justice said on Thursday Henri de Compte is eligible for 1 million Belgian Francs for injury suffered while an employee of the European Parliament.
The court struck down two earlier decisions by the Court of First Instance which rejected Compte's claims that he suffered a mental breakdown after being demoted on charges of misconduct.
The Parliament decided in January 1991 that de Compte did suffer a permanent disability, and granted a 40 percent partial disabilty, in the amount of 9,147,091 francs.

In April of the same year, the Parliament withdrew its decision with a new finding that de Compte did not suffer an on-the-job injury, as illnesses sustained while performing one's normal duties did not fall into that category.
The Parliament applied the decision retroactively and withdrew the award to de Compte.
De Compte challenged the Parliament, and the CFI decision arguing he took his decision to retire based on a legitimate expectation of the disability award.
The court agreed and told the Parliament it took too long to change its mind. The court reinstated the award, with interest from January, 1991.
ayant pour objet un pourvoi forme contre l'arret du Tribunal de premiere instance De Compte/Parlement T-90/91 et T-62/92,RecFP p. II-1
l'autre partie a la procedure etant

1. L'arret du Tribunal de premiere instance De Compte/Parlement T-90/91 et T-62/92, RecFP p. II-1 est annule, sauf en ce qu'il condamne le Parlement europeen a verser au requerant une somme de 200,000 BFR a titre de reparation du dommage moral.
2/ Dans l'affaire T-90/91, la decision du 18 avril 1991 est annulee.
3. Dans l'affaire T-62/92, la decsion du 20 janvier 1992 est annule.

4. Le Parlement europeen est condamne a verser au requerant une somme de 9,147,091 BFR, majoree d'interets moratoire au taux de 8 percent l'an a compter du 24 janvier 1991 jusqu'au jour du paiement effectif.
5. Le Parlement europeen est condamne a l'ensemble des depens des deux instances.
